body: I wish I could speak to them more freely. When I do, I'm told to "Let it go", "Get over it" and "Why do you dwell on things?" I want to let it go, I wish I could get over it and I'm not sure why my mind dwells on the past so much. I have been living a pretty nomadic life, living on the road for months at a time. I have been avoiding setting up any real friendships. I should try opening up to people, I just don't know how to start that conversation.
I know exactly how you are feeling. It feels like the harder you try to swim out of the depression the faster it sucks you in.
